response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms), AVG(num_tracks) FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) as avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) as num_tracks FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY MediaTypeId) t

assumptions.assumption: Milliseconds is always positive (non-zero) in the Track table to avoid division by zero in the Bytes ÷ Milliseconds calculation.
